name: Divider
structurePatterns: a 1px horizontal hairline in border-subtle color
full-bleed variant spans container width; inset variant aligns to content start (e.g. 12px in lists)
used between list rows, sections, and card content, not as decorative brand element
usageHints: not a brand decoration; use neutral subtle color
inset aligns to content start in lists (after leading icons/avatars)
prefer spacing rhythm over heavy dividers
